card.name: Small largest prime factor of consecutive-integer products

task.name: Small largest prime factor of consecutive-integer products
task.description: Return integer n in [10000,1000000]. Minimize the largest prime factor of n(n+1), independently computed by exact trial division. Searches a bounded window for smooth consecutive integers. The local lower cutoff prevents the trivial pair 1,2; it proves no asymptotic bound.
